column7: STARTUP-GUARD-TAILS-1 item 3 (follow-up to REVIEW-SERVERGUARD-RECOVERYKEY-1 F5). localStorageDBFile and acquireSQLiteMigrationLock took a SQLite file: URI as a literal relative path: prepareLocalStorageFile pre-created a junk file:... tree and the real database was born at the process umask until tightenExistingLocalStorageFiles fixed it after Open (#1647 layer bypassed), and a process on the URI and one on the plain path took different migration locks on one database; a mode=memory directory name also disabled both. Both now use internal/sqlitepath.DatabaseFile, the resolver the serverguard sidecar uses, and the test shares its spelling table with TestSQLiteURISpellings_MeetOnTheSameLock. Also TestCreateLocalStorage_URISpelling_BornSecureWithNoJunk and TestLocalStorageDBFile_OnlyTheQueryMarksInMemory (all red on the base by behaviour).
